# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## Working Principles (user-mandated, 最高优先级)

用户时间与预算有限，**每个任务都必须为省时间/省 token 服务**：

- **最短路径**：只为当前任务做最小必要改动；不顺手重构、不新增无关文件、不写长篇注释或文档。
- **省 token 的读法**：先用 grep/glob 定位，再带 offset/limit 定点读；禁止重复整文件读取或整文件回显；改动优先用 edit，不要重写大文件。
- **少开 agent**：默认由 Lead 单独完成。只有当任务可拆成互不依赖的大块、且并行确实更快时才用 teammates；subagent 的上下文同样是成本。
- **验证从简**：本项目无测试套件，只做必要的最小验证（如 GDScript 语法/加载检查），不跑完整试玩流程，除非任务明确要求。
- **输出精简**：结论先行，只列改动点与验证结果，不复述代码。
- **任务完成必须弹 Windows 通知**：每次交付结束前执行
  `pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts\dev\notify.ps1 -Title "HonorKing · <任务名>" -Message "<一句话结果>"`
  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

{"id":"task-9","revision":1,"subject":"大厅/房间/联机选人页全屏化 + 背景 + 按钮质感（NetLobby.gd）","description":"目标（全屏 + 质感 + 背景 三原则）：把 scripts/net/NetLobby.gd 的大厅菜单页、房间页、联机选人页改成"铺满屏幕"版式，并接入统一背景与按钮质感。

现状：_build_base() 用 CenterContainer + VBoxContainer(560 宽按钮、居中)，三个页面都挤在中间一小块，四周大片空白。屏幕虚拟尺寸 2400×1400，缩放系数 UiKit.scale()（2400 宽时 1.35）。

必须遵守：
1) 只改 scripts/net/NetLobby.gd；不要动 UiKit.gd / BattleManager.gd / UI_Manager.gd / ResultsPanel.gd / NetResultPanel.gd。
2) 背景：在 _build_base() 里加 UiKit.make_backdrop(self, UiKit.C_TEAM0, 1.0)（会铺满并置于底层），保留原全屏不透明底 ColorRect（可改成仅在本体使用）——注意背景要盖住默认 clear color。
3) 菜单页 _show_menu()：改为两栏铺满布局（用 anchor/offset 或 HBoxContainer + expand）：
   - 左栏（约 42% 宽）：品牌区——大标题"荣耀王者"（96px 级别，_fs(UiKit.FS_HUGE)*2 之类尽量大但同时用 _fs 档位表达）、副标题、下面留白、底部放版本/状态行；
   - 右栏（剩余宽度）：菜单按钮列，按钮尺寸 640×96、字体 _fs(FS_XL)、间距 20，垂直居中；
   - 左右内边距 64，上下 40；菜单按钮使用 UiKit.skin_button(state, accent, filled) 生成 normal/hover/pressed 三态（单机键用金色 filled，联机键用青色描边、退出/返回用危险色描边）。

1: # NetLobby.gd — 匹配大厅（单机 / 建房 / 加入 / 大厅选人）
2: #
3: # 界面态：
4: #   MENU    标题 + 单机/建房/加入（IP:端口 可编辑）
5: #   ROOM    在线名单；host 有「开始选人」，guest 等房主发起
6: #   SELECT  大厅选人：host 与每个 client 各自窗口选「职责→英雄→召唤师」并锁定；
7: #           前 5 席全员锁齐后 host 的「开始对局」才点亮（严格一人一职，空位 AI 补）
8: #
9: # 开局流程：host 点「开始选人」→ NetSession.begin_pick()（phase=SELECT）
10: #   → host 点「开始对局」（全员锁齐才允许）→ NetSession.start_match()（phase=BATTLE）
11: #   → host 进 scenes/battle.tscn（按锁定阵容直接开局，不再弹 BM 选人）
12: #   → client 进 scenes/net_client.tscn，开局后接管自己在选人阶段锁定的英雄
13: #
14: # CLI 直连（--net-host/--net-join，cli_mode=true）不进大厅：
15: #   host → battle.tscn；client → net_client.tscn（保留旧双窗/CI 流程）。
16: #
17: # 纯 Control 界面，代码搭建（无 .tscn UI 资源）。中文 UI，所有 GDScript 用 TAB 缩进。
18: 
19: extends Control
20: 
21: enum UIState { MENU, ROOM, SELECT }
22: 
23: const BTN_W := 560.0
24: const BTN_H := 76.0
25: 
26: # 统一调色板（取自 UiKit，保留 COL_* 变量名避免大范围改引用）
27: var COL_BG: Color = UiKit.C_PANEL_BG
28: var COL_TITLE: Color = UiKit.C_GOLD
29: var COL_SUB: Color = UiKit.C_TEXT_DIM
30: var COL_TEXT: Color = UiKit.C_TEXT
31: var COL_DIM: Color = UiKit.C_TEXT_DISABLED
32: var COL_OK: Color = UiKit.C_HEAL
33: var COL_ERR: Color = UiKit.C_DANGER
34: var COL_GOLD: Color = UiKit.C_GOLD
35: 
36: var _stack: VBoxContainer
37: var _ui := UIState.MENU

39: var _connecting := false
40: var _menu_btns: Array[Button] = []

697: func _on_lobby_state(state: Dictionary) -> void:
698: 	if NetSession.cli_mode:
699: 		return
700: 	var ph := int(state.get("phase", NetSession.Phase.LOBBY))
701: 	_set_menu_enabled(true)
702: 	if _role == -1:
703: 		_role = 1 if NetSession.mode == NetSession.Mode.CLIENT else 0
704: 	if ph == NetSession.Phase.SELECT:
705: 		# 大厅选人阶段：host 与每个 client 同屏选人。
706: 		# 每次状态事件都整体重建面板（他人锁定改灰 / 掉线腾出职责 / 旁观升席都即时生效；
707: 		# _adopt_self_choice 会保留本机未锁草稿，锁定态则采纳权威值）。
708: 		_show_select(state)
709: 		return
710: 	if ph == NetSession.Phase.BATTLE:
711: 		# 房主已开局（或加入时主机已在打）→ host 开战局、client 接管对战
712: 		if _role == 0:
713: 			_route_battle()
714: 		else:
715: 			_route_client()
716: 		return
717: 	# LOBBY：确认身份后进房间并刷新名单
718: 	if _ui == UIState.MENU:
719: 		_show_room()
720: 		_refresh_room(state)
721: 	else:
722: 		_refresh_room(state)

lines.text: # NetLobby.gd — 匹配大厅（单机 / 建房 / 加入 / 大厅选人）
#   MENU    标题 + 单机/建房/加入（IP:端口 可编辑）
#   ROOM    在线名单；host 有「开始选人」，guest 等房主发起
#   SELECT  大厅选人：host 与每个 client 各自窗口选「职责→英雄→召唤师」并锁定；

var edge := Color(0.9, 0.9, 1.0, 0.3) if hovered else Color(0.9, 0.9, 1.0, 0.15)

return "主机" if NetSession.mode == NetSession.Mode.HOST else "玩家"

return multiplayer.get_unique_id() if multiplayer != null else 2

253:

255: const BACKDROP_SCRIPT := preload("res://scripts/ui/UiBackdrop.gd")
256: 
257: 
258: ## 给全屏 Control 铺一层程序化背景（置于最底层，自动铺满），返回背景节点。
259: func make_backdrop(parent: Control, accent: Color = C_TEAM0, glow: float = 1.0) -> Control:
260: 	if parent == null:
261: 		return null
262: 	var bd: Control = BACKDROP_SCRIPT.new()
263: 	bd.accent = accent
264: 	bd.glow_strength = glow
265: 	parent.add_child(bd)
266: 	bd.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
267: 	parent.move_child(bd, 0)
268: 	return bd
269: 
270: 
271: ## 把统一主题挂到某个 Control 上：definite 面板根节点用，子节点自动继承。
272: func apply_theme(control: Control) -> void:
273: 	if control != null and _ui_theme != null and control.theme == null:
274: 		control.theme = _ui_theme
275: 
276: 
277: ## —— 动效 ——
278: ## 面板打开：透明度 0→1（150ms 缓出），不改变布局与锚点。
279: func show_panel(control: Control, dur: float = 0.15) -> void:
280: 	if control == null or not is_instance_valid(control):
281: 		return
282: 	control.visible = true
283: 	control.modulate.a = 0.0
284: 	var tw := create_tween()
285: 	tw.tween_property(control, "modulate:a", 1.0, dur).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
286: 
287: 
288: ## 面板关闭：透明度 1→0 后隐藏（120ms 缓入）。
289: func hide_panel(control: Control, dur: float = 0.12) -> void:
290: 	if control == null or not is_instance_valid(control):
291: 		return
292: 	if not control.visible:
293: 		return
294: 	var tw := create_tween()
295: 	tw.tween_property(control, "modulate:a", 0.0, dur).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
296: 	tw.tween_callback(func(): if is_instance_valid(control): control.visible = false)
297: 
298: 
299: ## 按钮按下反馈：0.96 缩放回弹（pivot 居中），移动端附加轻震动。
300: func punch(control: Control, amount: float = 0.96, dur: float = 0.10) -> void:
301: 	if control == null or not is_instance_valid(control):
302: 		return
303: 	control.pivot_offset = control.size * 0.5
304: 	var tw := create_tween()
305: 	tw.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2.ONE * amount, dur * 0.4).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
306: 	tw.tween_property(control, "scale", Vector2.ONE, dur * 0.6).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
307: 	haptic(10)
308: 
309: 
310: ## 轻震动（仅移动端，毫秒）。
311: func haptic(ms: int = 12) -> void:
312: 	if OS.has_feature("mobile"):
313: 		Input.vibrate_handheld(ms)
314: 
315: 
316: ## 与既有 UI_Manager.ui_scale() 完全一致的尺度（本批不改视觉，仅统一来源）。
317: func scale() -> float:
318: 	var vp := get_viewport()
319: 	if vp == null:
320: 		return SCALE_EXTRA
321: 	return maxf(1.0, vp.get_visible_rect().size.x / DESIGN_W) * SCALE_EXTRA
322: 
323: 
324: ## 安全区内缩（虚拟像素，Vector4: left/top/right/bottom）。
325: ## 仅在移动端生效；桌面返回全 0，避免 Windows 上 safe_area 是整块屏幕导致误缩。
326: func safe_insets() -> Vector4:
327: 	if not OS.has_feature("mobile"):
328: 		return Vector4.ZERO
329: 	var win := DisplayServer.window_get_size()
330: 	if win.x <= 0 or win.y <= 0:
331: 		return Vector4.ZERO
332: 	var sa := DisplayServer.get_display_safe_area()
333: 	if sa.size.x <= 0 or sa.size.y <= 0:
334: 		return Vector4.ZERO
335: 	var vp := get_viewport()
336: 	if vp == null:
337: 		return Vector4.ZERO
338: 	var vs := vp.get_visible_rect().size
339: 	var sx := vs.x / float(win.x)
340: 	var sy := vs.y / float(win.y)
341: 	return Vector4(
342: 		maxf(0.0, float(sa.position.x)) * sx,
343: 		maxf(0.0, float(sa.position.y)) * sy,
344: 		maxf(0.0, float(win.x - sa.position.x - sa.size.x)) * sx,
345: 		maxf(0.0, float(win.y - sa.position.y - sa.size.y)) * sy
346: 	)
347: 
348: 
349: func safe_top() -> float:
350: 	return safe_insets().y
351: 
352: 
353: func safe_bottom() -> float:
354: 	return safe_insets().w
355: 
356: 
357: func safe_left() -> float:
358: 	return safe_insets().x
359: 
360: 
361: func safe_right() -> float:
362: 	return safe_insets().z
363: 
364: 
365: ## 顶部锚定的控件统一避让刘海/挖孔：整体下移 + 高度不变。
366: func apply_safe_top(control: Control, extra: float = 0.0) -> void:
367: 	if control == null:
368: 		return
369: 	var inset := safe_top() + extra
370: 	if inset <= 0.0:
371: 		return
372: 	control.offset_top += inset
373: 	control.offset_bottom += inset
374: 
375: 
376: ## 底部锚定的控件统一避让手势条。
377: func apply_safe_bottom(control: Control, extra: float = 0.0) -> void:
378: 	if control == null:
379: 		return
380: 	var inset := safe_bottom() + extra
381: 	if inset <= 0.0:
382: 		return
383: 	control.offset_top -= inset
384: 	control.offset_bottom -= inset

5: 
6: var accent := Color(0.32, 0.62, 1.0)
7: var particle_count := 42
8: var glow_strength := 1.0
9: var show_grid := true
10: var vignette := true
11: 
12: var _t := 0.0
13: var _particles: Array = []
14: 
15: 
16: func _ready() -> void:
17: 	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
18: 	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
19: 	for i in particle_count:

21: 	set_process(true)
22:

24: func _process(delta: float) -> void:
25: 	_t += delta
26: 	queue_redraw()
27:

29: func _draw() -> void:
30: 	var s := size
31: 	if s.x <= 1.0 or s.y <= 1.0:
32: 		return
33: 	# 1) 纵向渐变底（24 条，深海军蓝 -> 略亮的墨蓝）
34: 	var steps := 24
35: 	for i in steps:
36: 		var k := float(i) / float(steps - 1)
37: 		var c := Color(0.020, 0.028, 0.048).lerp(Color(0.060, 0.082, 0.128), k)
38: 		draw_rect(Rect2(0.0, s.y * k, s.x, s.y / float(steps) + 2.0), c)
39: 	# 2) 中心辉光（同心圆叠加，缓慢呼吸）
40: 	var ctr := Vector2(s.x * 0.5, s.y * 0.40)
41: 	var breath := 0.85 + 0.15 * sin(_t * 0.35)
42: 	var rings := 26
43: 	for i in rings:
44: 		var r := s.x * (0.10 + 0.55 * float(i) / float(rings))
45: 		var a := 0.010 * glow_strength * breath * (1.0 - float(i) / float(rings))

51: 		var x := -s.y
52: 		while x < s.x:

60: 		var py := fmod(p.y * s.y - _t * 26.0 * p.z * 3.0 + s.y + sin(_t * 0.7 + float(i) * 1.7) * 10.0, s.y + 20.0) - 10.0

73: 			draw_rect(Rect2(0.0, 0.0, d * 0.6, s.y), Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, a))

Note: backdrop draws at full rect but needs to be below. Also note that the original `_build_base` adds an opaque ColorRect that would cover the backdrop if added after. So: add opaque bg first, then backdrop? Requirement #2 says: "背景：在 _build_base() 里加 UiKit.make_backdrop(self, UiKit.C_TEAM0, 1.0)（会铺满并置于底层），保留原全屏不透明底 ColorRect（可改成仅在本体使用）——注意背景要盖住默认 clear color。"

Hmm, make_backdrop moves itself to child index 0 (bottom). So the opaque ColorRect will be above the backdrop → backdrop hidden. Solution: make the opaque ColorRect either be a fallback behind... but it can't be behind since backdrop is moved to index 0. Options: keep the opaque ColorRect as a base fill but put it under the backdrop by calling make_backdrop first then... no, make_backdrop always moves to index 0.

Approach: Clear color issue — the viewport's default clear color. Actually the backdrop itself draws opaque gradient rects covering full size, but only after _process/ready with size. During the first frame before size is set, there could be flashes. Simplest: replace the opaque ColorRect usage: keep a ColorRect but make it the *root* background — wait, the requirement says "保留原全屏不透明底 ColorRect（可改成仅在本体使用）". Interpretation: keep an opaque full-screen ColorRect behind, and add the backdrop on top of it but still behind the UI. But make_backdrop forces index 0. So order: add_backdrop first (index 0), then add the opaque ColorRect → index 1 which covers backdrop. Bad.

Alternative: keep the opaque ColorRect as the base layer by manually creating backdrop without move? But requirement says use UiKit.make_backdrop(self, ...). We can call make_backdrop then add the ColorRect, then move backdrop to index 0 via `move_child`. Actually we can just after adding the opaque ColorRect, call `move_child(bd, 0)`. That keeps the opaque rect at index 1 above the backdrop → still covers.

Actually think about what "背景要盖住默认 clear color" means: the backdrop's gradient starts at 0.020,0.028,0.048 which is opaque; drawn over the viewport — as long as the Control behind is not over it. The issue: default clear color (project's environment/rendering clear) shows through where nothing drawn. If the backdrop draws full-rect opaque gradient from frame 1, fine. The only risk is the first frame where size is 0.

Better solution: keep the opaque ColorRect as the bottom-most layer (index 0) providing an immediate opaque fill, then backdrop above it (index 1) filling everything with gradient. But make_backdrop moves to 0... Then we can explicitly re-move:

```
var bg := ColorRect.new()  # 底层不透明兜底
...
var bd := UiKit.make_backdrop(self, UiKit.C_TEAM0, 1.0)  # 置于底层
move_child(bg, 0)  # 兜底色仍在背景之下
```
That satisfies both: the opaque rect stays at the very bottom (covers default clear color before backdrop draws), backdrop above it.

Hmm but the instruction "背景要盖住默认 clear color" — with bg at index 0 opaque and backdrop above, backdrop covers the solid color. The gradient covers all. Fine.

Then the panel content layer at the end. But the UI content is added later via add_child → above.

Also the backdrop should be positioned right below the content. Since the content layer is added after (bg, bd, panel), the order is [bg, bd, panel] → good.

Actually wait: `make_backdrop` calls `parent.add_child(bd)` then move_child(bd, 0). If I create bg ColorRect first (index 0), then bd added (index 1), then move bd to 0 → bg becomes index 1 and covers backdrop. So then I'd do `move_child(bg, 0)` after. Good.

Now for the layout. Current design virtual size 2400×1400, scale factor = max(1.0, vp.x/2400)*1.35 = 1.35 at 2400 wide. Hmm, that means font sizes multiply by 1.35, so FS_HUGE=34 → 46. Existing menu title uses 74 hardcoded. Requirement: 大标题"荣耀王者" 96px 级别, "_fs(UiKit.FS_HUGE)*2 之类尽量大但同时用 _fs 档位表达". _fs(FS_HUGE)=46, *2=92. So use `_fs(UiKit.FS_HUGE) * 2` → 92 at 2400 width. Good.

Now the layout architecture. I need to restructure `_build_base`:

- `_root`: full-rect MarginContainer? Or just a Control with a VBoxContainer full rect with margins. Keep `_stack` as the right-column container per the hint: "建议保留 _stack 引用但改为右栏容器，或重排 _build_base（_clear_stack 只清 _stack 子节点）".

Hmm. Design: each page rebuilds its content. The simplest robust approach: `_build_base` creates:
- bg ColorRect (opaque)
- backdrop
- `_page` : Control/MarginContainer full rect (margins 64 left/right, 40 top/bottom) — actually use a MarginContainer full-rect with margins.
- `_stack` = VBoxContainer inside page, as before? But different pages need different layouts. We could have `_column` be a generic container that each page fills with a root control.

Simplest: keep one "page root" container: `_page` (MarginContainer full rect, with theme constants margins) and `_stack` = VBoxContainer child of `_page` (full). `_clear_stack()` clears `_stack` children. Each page adds a top-level layout control to `_stack` that expands.

For the menu: `_stack` VBox contains an HBoxContainer with size_flags_vertical EXPAND_FILL; left brand column (42% via stretch ratio) and right menu column. To get 42% width, use HBoxContainer with left Control's `size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL` and `size_flags_stretch_ratio = 42.0` vs right 58.0. That's a clean approach without manual anchors.

For the room page: HBox with left (stretch 65) seats panel and right (stretch 35) status/start column.

For select page: needs specific widths: 左英雄列表 760 宽、中间英雄预览、右召唤师技能列, bottom confirm 680×92. Use HBox: hero_scroll min width 760, summ_panel min width 380, middle preview column expand. Hmm "中间英雄预览" — currently there's no hero preview. The task says 选人页左英雄列表 760 宽、中间英雄预览、右召唤师技能列. Do I need to add a hero preview? The current implementation has 左英雄列表 + 右召唤师技能. Task description says "中间英雄预览" — that implies adding a middle column showing selected hero preview (name/role/summoner). That's a reasonable enhancement: currently `_pick_summary` shows selected. I could add a center column with the current selection (职责/英雄/召唤师) as a preview card. Hmm, task 5 says "所有按钮保持原有回调与文本，不改状态机/网络逻辑/字段名" — adding a preview panel is UI-only, fine. But minimal change principle... The task explicitly lists 中间英雄预览 as part of the layout requirement, so I'll add a simple preview card in the middle showing 已选英雄/职责/召唤师 (from _sel_hero/_sel_sid, and locked state). Keep it lean.

Now, `_stack` needs theme separation 18 maybe; each page adds one child.

Also the version label at bottom-left using position offset — keep. Actually with margin layout, prefers explicit; keep as is but it overlays; fine. Set anchors preset BOTTOM_LEFT then position... they used set_anchors_preset + position which for a Control with preset bottom-left sets offsets based on position; size defaults 0. Label auto-sizes? It works apparently. Keep unchanged.

Now, page block backdrops: add skin_chip/skin_card panels. E.g., left brand area with a card, menu column maybe each button with skin_button.

Let me now design the code concretely.

Constants: BTN_W 560→640, BTN_H 76→96. BTN_W is used for hint custom_minimum_size and title widths. Task says 按钮尺寸 640×96. Keep BTN_W=640, BTN_H=96.

`_mk_btn(text, color)` currently uses _fs(FS_LG) and 3 states. Change to use UiKit.skin_button with accent. Need filled flag and disabled style. Let me extend signature? Requirement #5: "所有按钮保持原有回调与文本" — text and callbacks unchanged. Signature can change. But there are many call sites with (text, color). I could add an optional accent/filled param:

```
func _mk_btn(text: String, accent: Color, filled := false, w := BTN_W, h := BTN_H) -> Button
```

Then call sites: single-player gold filled; host cyan? Task: "单机键用金色 filled，联机键用青色描边、退出/返回用危险色描边". So:
- 单机游戏: gold filled
- 创建房间 / 加入房间: C_TEAM0 描边 (filled=false)
- 开始选人: 绿色 (C_HEAL?) 现在 Color(0.30,0.62,0.35) → maybe filled with C_HEAL? Task says 联机键用青色描边... "开始选人" is a primary action; use gold filled? Hmm. Keep accent from existing colors: 开始选人 green. Let's use: 开始选人 → C_HEAL filled (primary), 开始对局 → C_HEAL filled, 锁定选择 → C_TEAM0 filled, 离开房间 → C_DANGER 描边.

Existing colors mapping:
- b_single Color(0.16,0.28,0.44) → C_GOLD filled
- b_host Color(0.18,0.36,0.30) → C_TEAM0 outline
- b_join Color(0.32,0.26,0.42) → C_TEAM0 outline
- start_btn Color(0.30,0.62,0.35) → C_HEAL filled
- leave Color(0.42,0.22,0.24) → C_DANGER outline
- pick_confirm Color(0.24,0.46,0.62) → C_TEAM0 filled
- host_go Color(0.30,0.62,0.35) → C_HEAL filled

Disabled styles: skin_button("disabled", accent) — need `disabled` override for all buttons, plus font_disabled_color. Add in _mk_btn.

Also `_mk_btn` sets font_color etc.

`_card_style` → use UiKit.skin_card(color, hovered). Actually skin_card(accent, selected, alpha): for hover use selected=true (glow). For disabled use skin_button("disabled") or skin_card with gray. Rewrite `_mk_card_btn` to use UiKit.skin_card:

```
func _mk_card_btn(text, accent) -> Button:
	normal = UiKit.skin_card(accent)
	hover = UiKit.skin_card(accent, true)
	pressed = UiKit.skin_card(accent.darkened(0.3), true)
	disabled = UiKit.skin_button("disabled", accent)
```
Keep font sizes via _fs? Currently 20 hardcoded; task says 字号统一走 _fs(). Use _fs(FS_MD) for cards (20*1.35=27). Hmm that's bigger; card min size 150×54 → increase to 176×60 maybe. "按钮 min size 只增不减". OK.

Should `_card_style` be kept? It's only used by _mk_card_btn; remove and inline in _mk_card_btn. Removing a function that's only used internally is fine (minimal but clean). Actually keep it simple: replace body of _mk_card_btn and delete _card_style. Grep to confirm _card_style usage only there.

Also `_btn_style` used only in _mk_btn. Remove it.

Let's check for other references to _btn_style/_card_style/BTN_W across the file and other scripts.

### _build_base

```gdscript
func _build_base() -> void:
	# 底层兜底色（先铺，避免首帧透出默认 clear color）
	var bg := ColorRect.new()
	bg.color = Color(COL_BG.r, COL_BG.g, COL_BG.b, 1.0)
	bg.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	add_child(bg)

	# 程序化动态背景（渐变+辉光+网格+粒子+暗角），铺满并压在兜底色之上
	var bd := UiKit.make_backdrop(self, UiKit.C_TEAM0, 1.0)
	move_child(bg, 0)

	# 页面容器：铺满 + 安全内边距（左右 64 / 上下 40）
	_page = MarginContainer.new()
	_page.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_page.add_theme_constant_override("margin_left", int(64 * UiKit.scale()))
	_page.add_theme_constant_override("margin_right", int(64 * UiKit.scale()))
	_page.add_theme_constant_override("margin_top", int(40 * UiKit.scale()))
	_page.add_theme_constant_override("margin_bottom", int(40 * UiKit.scale()))
	_page.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_PASS
	add_child(_page)

	_stack = VBoxContainer.new()
	_stack.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
	_stack.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
```

Wait: the brand panel with `panel` style skin_chip — PanelContainer with VBox: the VBox min width will size the panel. In HBox with stretch ratios and expand flags, PanelContainer gets its share of width. children of panel need to expand to full width; VBox fills panel content area since PanelContainer fits child to content rect. Good; title label horizontal_alignment LEFT but as a VBox child it fills width and left-aligns text. Good.

Now the right column content: three buttons (SHRINK_CENTER), param row, status, hint. mcol alignment CENTER gives vertical centering of the group; but with a single expanding? All children have fixed heights, so group is centered. Good.

The hint at the bottom of the right column is fine.

Should the hint be inside the right panel? Yes, it's about联机说明. But its min width 640; on wide right column it fills full width → wraps at panel width. Set `hint.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(BTN_W, 0)`. Since it's in a VBox inside panel of ~1200 width, it fills to 1200 and wraps. Good.

Hmm, but with `mcol.alignment = CENTER` and a hint with autowrap, label height depends on width → fine.

Params row: center alignment; labels/LineEdit. Increase edit sizes: ip 240×54, port 110×54, font _fs(FS_MD)=27.

Let's also consider that LineEdit text font: use `_fs(UiKit.FS_MD)`.

Now "状态行" in left bottom: requirement said "底部放版本/状态行" — I put version line. The connection _status stays in right column near actions, which is better UX. OK.

Wait: the brand panel with `panel` style skin_chip — PanelContainer with VBox: the VBox min width will size the panel. In HBox with stretch ratios and expand flags, PanelContainer gets its share of width. children of panel need to expand to full width; VBox fills panel content area since PanelContainer fits child to content rect. Good; title label horizontal_alignment LEFT but as a VBox child it fills width and left-aligns text. Good.

Now the right column content: three buttons (SHRINK_CENTER), param row, status, hint. mcol alignment CENTER gives vertical centering of the group; but with a single expanding? All children have fixed heights, so group is centered. Good.

The hint at the bottom of the right column is fine.

Should the hint be inside the right panel? Yes, it's about联机说明. But its min width 640; on wide right column it fills full width → wraps at panel width. Set `hint.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(BTN_W, 0)`. Since it's in a VBox inside panel of ~1200 width, it fills to 1200 and wraps. Good.

Hmm, but with `mcol.alignment = CENTER` and a hint with autowrap, label height depends on width → fine.

Params row: center alignment; labels/LineEdit. Increase edit sizes: ip 240×54, port 110×54, font _fs(FS_MD)=27.

Let's also consider that LineEdit text font: use `_fs(UiKit.FS_MD)`.

Now "状态行" in left bottom: requirement said "底部放版本/状态行" — I put version line. The connection _status stays in right column near actions, which is better UX. OK.

Also note requirement 3: 左栏（约 42% 宽）：品牌区——大标题"荣耀王者"（96px 级别...）, 副标题, 下面留白, 底部放版本/状态行. Matches.

Write it.

# 临时探针：实测大厅三页关键控件几何，用完即删

func _ready() -> void:
	var lobby: Control = load("res://scenes/lobby.tscn").instantiate()

	await get_tree().process_frame

	_dump(lobby, "MENU")

	lobby.call("_show_room")
	await get_tree().process_frame
	await get_tree().process_frame
	_dump(lobby, "ROOM")
	lobby.call("_show_select", {"phase": 2, "players": {1: "房主", 2: "玩家2"}, "picks": {}})
	await get_tree().process_frame
	await get_tree().process_frame
	_dump(lobby, "SELECT")
	get_tree().quit()


func _dump(root: Control, tag: String) -> void:
	print("==== ", tag, " ====")
	var page: Control = root.get("_page")
	print("page=", page.get_global_rect())
	var bd: Control = root.get_child(0) if root.get_child_count() > 0 else null
	print("child0=", bd.get_class() if bd != null else "none", " rect=", bd.get_global_rect() if bd != null else Rect2())
	var st: Control = root.get("_stack")
	print("stack=", st.get_global_rect())
	_walk(st, 1)


func _walk(n: Node, depth: int) -> void:
	if depth > 3:
		return
	for c in n.get_children():
		if not (c is Control):
			continue
		var ctl := c as Control
		var txt := ""
		if ctl is Button:
			txt = " text=" + (ctl as Button).text
		elif ctl is Label:
			txt = " text=" + (ctl as Label).text.substr(0, 24)
		elif ctl is LineEdit:
			txt = " text=" + (ctl as LineEdit).text
		if txt != "" or ctl is PanelContainer:
			print("  ".repeat(depth), ctl.get_class(), " ", ctl.name, txt,
				" pos=", ctl.global_position.round(), " size=", ctl.size.round(),
				" min=", ctl.get_combined_minimum_size().round())
		_walk(ctl, depth + 1)
"}

				" min=", ctl.get_combined_minimum_size().round())
		_walk(ctl, depth + 1)

content.text:
Pixels: near-black with slight blue-green variation — that's the backdrop gradient + vignette. Values like (0, 0.0118, 0.0235) and (0, 0.051, 0.0824) differ across points → gradient visible, not flat clear color. At (20,20) it's (0,0,0) — vignette darkening. Hmm, is the whole screen too dark? The gradient base is 0.020..0.060 in the backdrop; vignette multiplies down at edges. The sample at (700,700) gives (0, 0.051, 0.0824) — the glow adding green/blue. But red channel 0?? Gradient color (0.020,0.028,0.048) has red 0.02. Sampling shows (0.0, 0.0275, 0.0627) — red 0. Why 0?

Hmm, maybe the ColorRect bg is drawn over? No—bg is below backdrop. If the pixel were bg color (0.055,0.062,0.088) we'd see red 0.055.

Red=0 suggests something else drawn on top: maybe the theme Panel stylebox? Wait, page MarginContainer has no panel. Hmm.

Or the viewport image uses linear color space (HDR) and 3D environment? The lobby is a Control-only scene with default environment. In Godot, `get_image()` of a window viewport returns sRGB? Values with red exactly 0.0 at all sampled points is suspicious.

Wait maybe these screenshots are showing the *default clear color* which in Horizon... no, clear color would be uniform gray/black.

Actually look: values like (0, 0.051, 0.0824) = Color(0, 0.051, 0.0824). Hmm the backdrop's gradient Color(0.020, 0.028, 0.048) — red 0.020 would quantize to 5/255=0.0196, not 0. Unless... the image is in linear space and these are linear values? sRGB 0.020 → linear 0.0015 which would show as tiny nonzero, not exactly 0.

Hmm what if the backdrop draw is clipped and what we see is actually a dimmed version? Let's consider `CanvasModulate`? no.

Maybe the sampled points are covered by something: at (1200,700) is inside the select's preview panel? For menu at (700,700), that's inside the left brand panel (64..998, 40..1360) — panel bg C_PANEL_BG (0.055,0.062,0.088) with alpha 0.45 over backdrop → composite ≈ 0.45*panel + 0.55*backdrop ≈ (0.036, 0.043, 0.070)*... resulting red ~0.036, not 0.

So red=0 means colors are quantized/blended differently. Perhaps the image is 8-bit in linear? Hmm.

Alternatively, maybe what I'm seeing is a mostly-black viewport because the window is not rendered correctly under the console exe in this environment (software rendering?), and the different blue values are from ... hmm.

Let's not over-interpret. A cleaner check: read the bg pixel from a region definitely over the backdrop: e.g., in MENU, the top area between panels? There's no gap. Point (2380,700) is right edge, outside _page's right margin? The page covers full rect (0..2400) but its content is inset; the page itself is a MarginContainer with no drawing, so pixel = backdrop. Value (0,0,0.0157) — dark blue but red 0.

Hmm. Maybe there's a black overlay: `_page` mouse_filter PASS doesn't draw. The ColorRect bg at index 0 draws (0.055,0.062,0.088) then backdrop draws gradient with alpha 1 (opaque rects) → red should be 0.02.

Unless... the backdrop's first gradient covers but with `_draw` steps drawing rect widths `s.y / steps + 2` at y positions; fine.

What about sRGB vs linear in the project (Forward+)? get_texture().get_image() on a window with HDR/linear color space may return linear values. If the project uses "Linear" viewport color space, sRGB 0.020 → linear ~0.0015 → 8-bit 0. Then 0.028 sRGB → linear 0.0022 → 0/255=0; 0.048 → linear 0.0038 → 1/255=0.0039. Observed 0.0118-0.0824 → these correspond to linear values of sRGB ~0.11-0.30. Hmm.

Regardless, the relative variation confirms a gradient-ish rendering. But is it "too dark"? Hard to judge. The task's aesthetic is 深海军蓝底 + 背景; UiKit.make_backdrop is the mandated background, so whatever it renders is what the batch uses everywhere. Fine.

But wait — red channel exactly 0 at ALL points (20 points across 3 pages) is a strong signal: perhaps the whole image is dominated by the *clear color* (0,0,0) and only some elements... no, then all points would be identical.

Let me sample more points and print as 8-bit ints to judge. Or simply sample a horizontal line to see the gradient. Not critical, but I want to ensure the backdrop is actually rendering and not something else. Let me print a bigger sample set with int conversion and also compare with/without backdrop? Quick test: sample many points, print byte values. If the glow ring near center (1200,560) is brighter, the backdrop is working.

Actually, another thought: red=0 could be caused by the image being in linear space where the gradient's red 0.020 → 0.0015 → 0. The green: 0.028 sRGB → linear 0.0022 → 1/255=0.0039; we saw 0.0118 = 3/255... plausible for glow contribution 0.010*accent → linear ~0.0028... So the image likely is linear-space, making everything look near-black. In sRGB display it would look like the design.

OK — I'm reasonably confident the backdrop renders (variation matches expected pattern: brighter at center/glow, dark at corners). The pixel variation across samples (0, 0.0118, 0.0235) vs (0, 0.051, 0.0824) confirms non-uniform background.

Good enough. Actually let me do a decisive check: count distinct colors in the whole image and check a horizontal scanline to see the smooth gradient. Quick add to probe: sample 40 points along y=1200 and print blue values; if monotonic smooth variation → backdrop. But we already have variation at corners vs center. Fine.

One more important check: are the panels opaque enough that content is readable? Panel alpha 0.45 over dark bg → panel is dark (C_PANEL_BG 0.055.. at 0.45 alpha over backdrop) → quite dark, good contrast with white text.

Now final checks:
1. Re-run the windowed lobby scene check for errors (after latest edits).
2. Run headless editor parse check again (may still show BattleManager errors from teammate, but confirm no NetLobby errors).
3. Delete probe files (and .uid if created).
4. Verify no stray files.
5. Send message to lead.

Also double check the file for consistency — read the modified sections once more quickly for e.g. duplicated `var st` or ordering issues (rcol: lead, st, start...). Let me view the room section.

【改动摘要】
1. _build_base：先铺不透明 ColorRect（兜底 clear color）→ UiKit.make_backdrop(self, C_TEAM0, 1.0) 并 move_child(bg,0) 使其仍在最底 → MarginContainer 安全区（左右 64 / 上下 40）→ _stack 铺满。删掉原来的 CenterContainer 居中堆叠与左下角版本行。
2. 新增 _panel_block(accent, alpha, radius, pad)：UiKit.skin_chip 半透明底板（描边压到 40% 透明度，无纯亮底）。
3. _mk_btn → UiKit.skin_button(normal/hover/pressed/disabled) 四态；签名 (text, accent, filled=false, min_size=ZERO)，默认 640×96、字体 _fs(FS_XL)、SHRINK_CENTER；所有调用点仅换配色：单机=金 filled，建房/加入=青描边，开始选人/开始对局=绿 filled，锁定选择=青 filled，离开=危险色描边。文本与回调一字未改。_mk_card_btn → UiKit.skin_card（hover 选中发光），min 150×54→176×62，字号 _fs(FS_MD)；删除 _btn_style/_card_style。
4. _show_menu：两栏铺满 HBox（42% / 58%，sep 48）。左栏品牌块：金色 chip 底 + 大标题「荣耀王者」_fs(FS_HUGE)*2=92px（实测字高 123）+ 副标题 _fs(FS_LG) + 金线 + 一句话说明 + 中部留白 + 底部版本行；右栏青色 chip 底 + 按钮列垂直居中（间距 20）+ IP/端口行（240×54 / 120×54，_fs(FS_MD)）+ 状态行 + 说明。
5. _show_room：两栏 HBox（65% / 35%，sep 40）。左=青色 chip 名单块（标题 _fs(FS_HUGE)*1.7、身份/在线/玩家列表 _fs(FS_LG)、名单 line_spacing 20 = 行高加大、纵向 expand、底部规则说明）；右=金色 chip 状态块（上留白 + 状态 + 开始选人/等待提示 + 下留白 + 说明 + 离开房间）。
6. _show_select：改为铺满四段：顶部标题条（_fs(FS_HUGE)=46）+ 席位总览 chip + 三栏主区（左英雄列表 760 固定宽含 3 列英雄卡 / 中英雄预览自适应 1092 / 右召唤师技能 380）+ 底部状态摘要按钮条（确认 680×92、开始对局 680×92、离开 640×96）。新增中栏预览（_preview_name/_role/_summ + _refresh_preview()，随选英雄/召唤师实时刷新、职责色描边），滚动收在英雄列表/召唤师列内部，删掉原来包整页的外层 ScrollContainer。
7. _clear_stack 额外清空指向已释放控件的缓存（_status/_roster_lab/_start_btn/_seat_lab/_preview_* 等），避免跨页误刷新；状态机/网络逻辑/字段名未动。

【实测几何（2400×1400，UiKit.scale()=1.35）】
MENU：_page (0,0) 2400×1400，_stack (64,40) 2272×1320；左品牌块 (64,40) 934×1320（42.0%），右菜单块 (1046,40) 1290×1320；标题「荣耀王者」font 92 / 字高 123；按钮 单机 (1371,427) 640×96、创建房间 (1321,543) 740×96（文本撑宽）、加入 (1371,659) 640×96；IP 行 y=775，状态 y=849，说明 y=902。
ROOM：左名单块 (64,40) 1450×1320（64.97%），右操作块 (1554,40) 782×1320；「对局房间」字高 104，玩家列表 line_spacing 20 且纵向撑到 953 高；开始选人 (1625,581) 640×96 居中、离开房间 (1625,1245) 640×96。
SELECT：标题条 (64,40) 2272×140、席位 chip (64,198) 2272×152、英雄列表 (64,368) 760×751（卡 176×62、每行 3 张）、英雄预览 (844,368) 1092×751、召唤师列 (1956,368) 380×751（按钮 344×62）、底部条 (64,1137) 2272×223，锁定选择 (178,1245) 680×96、开始对局 (880,1245) 680×96。
背景：根节点子级顺序 = ColorRect(全屏,0,0,2400×1400) → UiBackdrop(全屏) → MarginContainer 页面；采样 6 点像素在 (0,0.012,0.024)…(0,0.055,0.094) 之间变化，确认渐变/辉光在画、非纯 clear color。

【验证】
- 无头解析 `--headless --path . --editor --quit`：无任何 NetLobby 相关 SCRIPT ERROR；现存报错来自别的成员在改的文件（`_sel_card_style not found`、`Could not find type "RecItemCard"`）与既有 Minimap/日志目录告警。
- windowed `res://scenes/lobby.tscn --quit-after 240`：exit 0，无 SCRIPT ERROR / Invalid call / Nonexistent（仅 vsync、user:// 日志写盘、证书读取等环境噪声）。
- 临时探针（已删除，含 .uid）：实测三页几何、根节点层级、像素采样，以及选人交互路径 —— 点英雄→预览「吕布/战士」、选闪现→confirm.disabled=false、摘要「待锁定：战士 · 吕布 + 闪现」，_on_pick_confirm 走到原网络分支无运行时错误。"}

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

Python includes numpy, pandas, python-docx, python-pptx, openpyxl, Pillow, lxml, and XlsxWriter. Use these libraries for Office files unless the user or workspace instructions select another environment. When Node.js and pnpm paths are returned, run pnpm with that Node executable and pnpm script path. This does not change PATH or package-manager settings.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

```gdscript
func _show_select(state: Dictionary) -> void:

	_my_seat = 1
	for s in data["seats"]:
		if s.is_me:
			break
		_my_seat += 1
	_blocked_roles = {}
	for s in data["seats"]:
		if s.is_me:
			continue
		if str(s.role) != "":
			_blocked_roles[str(s.role)] = true
	_adopt_self_choice(state, data)
	_stack.add_child(_build_stage_bar(data, state))
	_stack.add_child(_build_select_main(data, state))
	_stack.add_child(_build_select_bottom(data, state))
	_refresh_preview()
	_refresh_select(state, data)
```

# 切职业 tab：重设 tab 样式并重建英雄卡条（"" = 全部）
func _select_tab(role: String) -> void:
	if role == _tab_role:
		return
	_tab_role = role
	for k in _tab_btns:
		var b: Button = _tab_btns[k]
		if is_instance_valid(b):
			var active: bool = str(k) == role
			var accent: Color = UiKit.C_GOLD if active else UiKit.C_TEAM0
			b.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", UiKit.skin_button("normal", accent, active))
			b.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", UiKit.skin_button("hover", accent, active))
			b.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE if active else COL_TEXT)
	_rebuild_strip()


# 按 _tab_role 重建底部英雄卡条
func _rebuild_strip() -> void:
	if _hero_strip == null:
		return
	for c in _hero_strip.get_children():
		_hero_strip.remove_child(c)
		c.queue_free()
	_hero_btns.clear()
	for role in HeroPickData.ROLES_ORDER:
		if _tab_role != "" and role != _tab_role:
			continue
		var rcol: Color = HeroPickData.ROLE_COLORS.get(role, COL_TEXT)
		for hname in HeroPickData.HERO_ROLE:
			if str(HeroPickData.HERO_ROLE[hname]) != role:
				continue
			var card := _mk_hero_card(hname, role, rcol)
			_hero_strip.add_child(card)
			_hero_btns[hname] = card
	_style_pick_cards()

func _select_tab(role: String) -> void:
	if role == _tab_role:
		return
	_tab_role = role
	for k in _tab_btns:
		var b: Button = _tab_btns[k]
		if is_instance_valid(b):
			var active: bool = str(k) == role
			var accent: Color = UiKit.C_GOLD if active else UiKit.C_TEAM0

	_rebuild_strip()


# 按 _tab_role 重建底部英雄卡条
func _rebuild_strip() -> void:
	if _hero_strip == null:
		return
	for c in _hero_strip.get_children():
		_hero_strip.remove_child(c)
		c.queue_free()
	_hero_btns.clear()
	for role in HeroPickData.ROLES_ORDER:
		if _tab_role != "" and role != _tab_role:
			continue
		var rcol: Color = HeroPickData.ROLE_COLORS.get(role, COL_TEXT)
		for hname in HeroPickData.HERO_ROLE:
			if str(HeroPickData.HERO_ROLE[hname]) != role:
				continue
			var card := _mk_hero_card(hname, role, rcol)
			_hero_strip.add_child(card)
			_hero_btns[hname] = card
	_style_pick_cards()

# 职业 tab 键
func _mk_tab_btn(text: String, accent: Color, active: bool) -> Button:
	var b := Button.new()
	b.text = text
	b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(132, 52)
	b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", _fs(UiKit.FS_MD))

	return b


# 切职业 tab：重设 tab 样式并重建英雄卡条（"" = 全部）
func _select_tab(role: String) -> void:
	if role == _tab_role:
		return
	_tab_role = role
	for k in _tab_btns:
		var b: Button = _tab_btns[k]
		if is_instance_valid(b):
			var active: bool = str(k) == role
			var accent: Color = UiKit.C_GOLD if active else UiKit.C_TEAM0
			b.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", UiKit.skin_button("normal", accent, active))
			b.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", UiKit.skin_button("hover", accent, active))
			b.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color.WHITE if active else COL_TEXT)
	_rebuild_strip()


# 按 _tab_role 重建底部英雄卡条
func _rebuild_strip() -> void:
	if _hero_strip == null:
		return
	for c in _hero_strip.get_children():
		_hero_strip.remove_child(c)
		c.queue_free()
	_hero_btns.clear()
	for role in HeroPickData.ROLES_ORDER:
		if _tab_role != "" and role != _tab_role:
			continue
		var rcol: Color = HeroPickData.ROLE_COLORS.get(role, COL_TEXT)
		for hname in HeroPickData.HERO_ROLE:
			if str(HeroPickData.HERO_ROLE[hname]) != role:
				continue
			var card := _mk_hero_card(hname, role, rcol)
			_hero_strip.add_child(card)
			_hero_btns[hname] = card
	_style_pick_cards()

	var b := Button.new()
	b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(180, 112)
	b.disabled = blocked
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", UiKit.skin_card(accent))

	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", UiKit.skin_card(accent.darkened(0.3), true))
	b.add_theme_stylebox_override("disabled", UiKit.skin_button("disabled", accent))
	b.pressed.connect(_pick_hero.bind(hname))
	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
	v.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	v.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	v.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	v.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
	var nm := _mk_label(hname, _fs(UiKit.FS_LG), COL_TEXT if not blocked else COL_DIM)
	nm.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	v.add_child(nm)

	return b


# 英雄卡/召唤师卡选中态（皮肤卡片高亮）
func _style_pick_cards() -> void:
	for k in _hero_btns:
		var b: Button = _hero_btns[k]
		if is_instance_valid(b) and not b.disabled:
			var role := str(HeroPickData.HERO_ROLE.get(str(k), ""))
			var rcol: Color = HeroPickData.ROLE_COLORS.get(role, COL_TEXT)
			b.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", UiKit.skin_card(rcol, str(k) == _sel_hero))
	for k in _summ_btns:
		var sb: Button = _summ_btns[k]
		if is_instance_valid(sb):
			sb.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal",
				UiKit.skin_card(Color(0.36, 0.46, 0.66), str(k) == _sel_sid))

		4: return "位移"

	return "通用"

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

tools.name: interrupt_agent
tools.description: Interrupt one teammate's current turn while preserving its pending inbox. Team Lead only.

target.description: Teammate target returned by spawn_teammate or list_agents.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.description: Request cancellation of a running background job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

tools.name: job_list
tools.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

tools.name: job_output
tools.description: Read a background job: output since the previous read for stream jobs, or the result of a finished final-output job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

wait.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List the Lead and every durable teammate with an addressable target and current availability. inactive means no turn is executing, not a task result. provisioning and failed describe member creation.

tools.name: load_workspace_dependencies
tools.description: Get absolute paths to bundled Python and library directories, plus bundled Python distribution versions. Node.js and pnpm paths are included when the payload provides them. Python includes numpy, pandas, python-docx, python-pptx, openpyxl, Pillow, lxml, and XlsxWriter. Use these libraries for Office files unless the user or workspace instructions select another environment. When Node.js and pnpm paths are returned, run pnpm with that Node executable and pnpm script path. This does not change PATH or package-manager settings.

tools.name: present
tools.description: Declare existing files as final deliverables for the user. Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. The user opens the current files; their contents are not copied.

files.description: Usually the 1-2 most important deliverables; at most 4 per call.

path.description: Path of an existing regular file. Relative paths use the Session working directory.

description.description: Brief description for the user.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

tools.name: read_image

tools.description: Create a reminder in the current session that delivers prompt when it becomes due. Supply exactly one timing parameter: after_seconds, at, every_seconds, daily, weekly, or cron. Local times that do not exist in the zone are skipped; repeated local times fire once, at the earlier instant. After downtime, a recurring reminder delivers only its latest missed occurrence. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

prompt.description: Reminder content to present when the target becomes due.

title.description: Concise task name in the user's language, at most 120 characters. Name only the core action and subject; keep essential target identifiers such as PR numbers and branch names. Do not include execution frequency (e.g. daily, hourly), scheduled dates/times, time zones, task status, or configuration and execution details (e.g. read-only mode, profile-tag filters), even when embedded in the requested or existing title. Do not append parenthetical notes. Put scheduling information in the timing parameters and execution instructions in prompt.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekly.description: On the given weekdays at a local time.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

# 中栏立绘/覆盖层：随本机草稿实时刷新（未选 = 提示胶囊，已选 = 3D 模型 + 职责色 + chip 行）
func _refresh_preview() -> void:
	if _preview_name == null:
		return
	var role := ""
	var rcol: Color = UiKit.C_TEAM0
	if _sel_hero != "":
		role = str(HeroPickData.HERO_ROLE.get(_sel_hero, ""))
		rcol = HeroPickData.ROLE_COLORS.get(role, UiKit.C_TEAM0)
		_preview_name.text = _sel_hero
		if _prev != null and is_instance_valid(_prev):
			_prev.set_hero(_sel_hero)
			_prev.set_accent(rcol)
	else:
		_preview_name.text = "请选择英雄"
	_preview_role.text = ("职责 · " + role) if role != "" else "职责 —"
	_preview_role.add_theme_color_override("font_color", rcol.lightened(0.2))
	if _prev_role_chip != null:
		_prev_role_chip.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", UiKit.skin_chip(rcol, 0.55, 12))
	_preview_summ.text = "召唤师 · " + (_sel_summ if _sel_summ != "" else "未选择")
	# 技能 chip 行：召唤师技能的类型/冷却/法力 + 可锁定状态
	if _prev_chip_row != null:
		for c in _prev_chip_row.get_children():
			_prev_chip_row.remove_child(c)
			c.queue_free()
		var sk: Skill = SkillDatabase.get_skill(_sel_sid) if _sel_sid != "" else null
		if sk != null:
			_prev_chip_row.add_child(_mk_chip("类型 " + _skill_kind(int(sk.type)), UiKit.C_TEAM0))
			_prev_chip_row.add_child(_mk_chip("冷却 %ds" % int(round(sk.cooldown)), UiKit.C_GOLD))
			if sk.mana_cost > 0:
				_prev_chip_row.add_child(_mk_chip("法力 %d" % int(sk.mana_cost), UiKit.C_AP))
		_prev_chip_row.add_child(_mk_chip(
			"可锁定" if (_sel_hero != "" and _sel_sid != "") else "先选英雄+召唤师",
			UiKit.C_HEAL if (_sel_hero != "" and _sel_sid != "") else UiKit.C_DANGER))
	_style_pick_cards()
