  （脚本已就绪，失败会静默降级，不阻断交付）。

## Project Overview

HonorKing — a 3D MOBA game built with **Godot 4.5** (Forward Plus renderer). All game logic is written in **GDScript**. The game simulates a 5v5 Honor of Kings-style match: one player-controlled hero plus 4 AI teammates versus 5 AI enemies across a three-lane map with jungle, turrets, and epic monsters.

## Development Commands

- **Run the game**: Open `project.godot` in the Godot 4.5 editor and press F5, or run `godot --path .` from the project root.
- **No tests, no build step**: There is no test suite or CI. The only way to verify changes is to run the game in the Godot editor.

## Architecture

### Autoloads (Globals)

Defined in `project.godot` → `[autoload]`. These singletons are available everywhere without `load()`:

| Autoload | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Config` | `scripts/core/Config.gd` | Constants: `MAP_SIZE=120`, `Team` enum (`PLAYER=0, ENEMY=1, NEUTRAL=2`) |
| `ItemDatabase` | `assets/ItemDatabase.gd` | All item definitions, synthesis trees, recommended build paths, `get_item()`, `can_build()`, `get_synthesis_cost()` |
| `SkillDatabase` | `assets/SkillDataBase.gd` | All skill definitions (hero skills + summoner spells), `get_skill()` |
| `GameManager` | `scripts/core/GameManager.gd` | Stub — currently empty (`_ready` and `_process` are no-ops) |
| `UiManager` | `scripts/ui/UI_Manager.gd` | Comprehensive UI: skill icons, shop, kill feed, hero detail panel (C key), target info, death recap, buff panel, damage/gold/heal popups |
| `CollisionSystem` | `scripts/core/CollisionSystem.gd` | Per-frame entity pushback to prevent overlapping (heroes ← → turrets, minions ← → turrets excluded) |

### Core Scripts (`scripts/core/`)

- **`BattleManager.gd`** — The central game controller (`class_name BattleManager`). Handles:
  - Map creation (ground planes, lane planes, river, high-ground circles)
  - Hero select UI → game start flow
  - Player hero + AI hero creation (one of each role: assassin/mage/marksman/warrior/support)
  - Turret, jungle camp, wall/bush placement
  - Minion wave spawning (3 lanes × 2 teams, with growth tables, siege/super/dragon minion variants)
  - Epic monster timers (Tyrant at 4min, Dragon at 4min)
  - Economy systems: kill/assist gold, tower gold, lane gold sharing, natural gold/exp, jungle item rules, support item rules
  - Input handling: left-click attack order, right-click move, raycasting for ground/target selection
  - Camera: follows player hero, minimap drag/jump override
  - Win condition: crystal destruction → game-over screen
  - Hero configs: `hero_configs` dictionary with base stats for all 17 heroes

- **`EntityDatabase.gd`** — Stub (empty `_ready`/`_process`).

- **`CameraController.gd`** — Standalone camera script (attached to a Camera3D), follows a `@export var target`. Currently unused — BattleManager controls the camera directly.

- **`MapGenerator.gd`** — Alternative map generator (creates a simpler 60×60 grass + river). Not used in the main game; BattleManager has its own `_create_map()`.

- **`CollisionSystem.gd`** — See Autoloads above.

### Entity Hierarchy (`scripts/entities/`)

All entities inherit from **`GameEntity`** (`class_name GameEntity extends CharacterBody3D`):

```
GameEntity
├── Hero (player & AI champions)
├── Turret (defensive structures)
├── Minion (lane creeps)
├── JungleMonster (neutral camps + epic monsters)
├── Bullet (projectile for ranged attacks and skill shots)
├── LinearBullet (directional projectile variant)
├── Wall (terrain obstacle)
├── Bush (stealth zone)
├── HealthPack (regen pickup)
├── TeleportZone (teleport pad)
└── prw (unidentified entity)
```

**`GameEntity`** provides:
- Base stats: `health`, `max_health`, `attack`, `armor`, `magic_resist`, `move_speed`, `attack_range`, `attack_speed`, `body_radius`, `level`
- State effects: slow, stun, knockup, freeze, suppress, silence, grievous wounds
- Shield system (`shield_remaining`/`shield_timer`)
- Marker system for stacking passives (e.g., Zhen Ji freeze, Angela burn, Marco Polo stacks)
- Damage calculation: `take_damage()` with armor/MR reduction formula (`resistance / (resistance + 602)`), penetration, crit detection
- Hunt DoT system (jungle item burn)
- Lifesteal application (physical and magical, with grievous wounds reduction)
- Death handling: `die(killer)` → signals, gold/exp distribution, buff transfer
- Kill assist detection (nearest enemy hero within 12 units)

**`Hero`** (`scripts/entities/Hero.gd`, ~2150 lines) — The largest and most complex class:
- **Stats**: base stats + role-based growth per level (tank/warrior/assassin/marksman/mage/support)
- **Equipment**: 6-slot inventory, `buy_equipment()` with component synthesis, `_apply_equipment_bonuses()` recalculates all stats from items, 100+ unique item passive/active effects
- **Skills**: 3 hero skills + summoner spell + recover, each with cooldowns, mana costs, charge/restore system, upgrade via Ctrl+key or auto-level
- **Hero-specific logic**: Each hero has hardcoded special behavior in `_physics_process()` (Arthur passive heal + W shield rotation, Donghuang orbs, Li Bai sword auras, Zhang Fei transformation + mana, Lanling stealth, Taiyi Q channeling)
- **Combat**: auto-attack with bullet spawning (ranged) or instant (melee), crit, on-hit effects from 20+ items
- **Input**: WASD movement, right-click move orders, left-click attack orders, skill hotkeys 1-3, summoner spell key, item actives (keys 6-0, V, =, -)
- **Post-game stats**: `damage_dealt_to_heroes`, `damage_taken_from_heroes`, `healing_done`, `cc_duration_dealt`, `turret_damage`, `jungle_gold`, `last_hits`, `gold_history`

**Other entity notes**:
- `Bullet.gd` / `LinearBullet.gd` — Projectiles with speed, damage, pierce, slow, red buff burn, team affiliation
- `Turret.gd` — Auto-attacks nearby enemies, has outer/inner/high/crystal tiers with different stats
- `Minion.gd` — Follows waypoints along lanes, attacks enemies in range
- `JungleMonster.gd` — Has `activity_radius` (leash range), `buff_type` for red/blue buff
- `Wall.gd` / `Bush.gd` — Static collision/stealth volumes
- `HeroAI.gd` — AI controller for bot heroes (attached as child of Hero)

### Asset Scripts (`assets/`)

- **`ItemDatabase.gd`** — Massive dictionary of all equipment items with: name, tier (1-4), cost, stat bonuses, `requires` (synthesis components), `passive`/`active` descriptions, category tags. Key functions: `get_item(id)`, `can_build(id, owned)`, `get_synthesis_cost()`, `get_synthesis_tree()`, `get_recommended_items(role)`.
- **`SkillDataBase.gd`** — Dictionary of all skills (hero abilities + summoner spells). Each skill defines: `type` (0=targeted, 1=AoE, 3=linear, 4=dash, 6=shield), `cooldown`, `mana_cost`, `cast_range`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, etc.
- **`Skill.gd`** — Skill resource class (`class_name Skill extends Resource`). Properties: `skill_name`, `type`, `cooldown`, `cd_bonus`, `mana_cost`, `power_bonus`, `cast_range`, `cast_time`, `damage`, `radius`, `duration`, `self_displacement`, `shield_amount`, `is_channeling`, `charge`, `restore`, `restore_bonus`.

### UI System (`scripts/ui/`)

**`UI_Manager.gd`** (~1600 lines) handles all in-game UI:
- Skill bar with 8 icon slots (4 skills + summoner + 2 active equipment)
- Shop system (O key): categorized grid (物理/法术/防御/靴子/打野/游走/保命), detail panel, buy/sell, component synthesis display
- Recommended equipment (B key to quick-buy)
- Kill feed (multi-kill announcements, tower/epic monster kills)
- Hero detail panel (C key): team stats, all hero cards with stats/skills/equipment/KDA
- Death recap (auto-shows on death): damage source breakdown with stacked bar charts
- Target detail panel (shows selected target's stats)
- Buff/debuff display panel
- Damage/heal/gold floating numbers (world-space → screen projection)
- Respawn widgets (hero icons with HP rings and respawn timers)

Internal classes: `SkillIcon` (draws cooldown overlay, upgrade indicator), `RespawnWidget` (HP ring + death timer), `DamageChart`.

### Key Mechanics to Understand

1. **Damage formula**: `actual_damage = raw_damage × (1 - resistance / (resistance + 602))` where resistance already accounts for flat and percentage penetration.
2. **Attack speed**: Uses a threshold table (Model A from Honor of Kings) — panel AS% maps to discrete attack interval tiers.
3. **Economy sharing**: Multiple heroes near a minion kill split gold (100%/80%/55%/43%/37% for 1-5 players). Jungle/support items modify this.
4. **Minion growth**: Minion stats interpolate from growth tables at `game_time / 60` minutes, with melee/ranged/siege/super/dragon variants.
5. **Item synthesis**: Buying a high-tier item that requires owned components only costs the difference. Selling refunds 70%.
6. **Buff system**: Active buffs are stored as dictionaries with timers, processed each frame in `_calculate_buff()`. Red/blue buffs transfer on kill.
7. **Hero-specific code**: Each hero has unique mechanics hardcoded with `if display_name == "..."` checks in `_physics_process()`, `_perform_attack()`, and `_finish_casting()`. Adding a new hero requires touching Hero.gd in multiple places plus adding skill definitions to SkillDatabase.

### Assets Not Tracked in Scripts

- `icon.svg` — Game icon
- `.godot/` — Engine cache (shader cache, editor state, import files)
- `scenes/battle.tscn` — The single main scene (binary .tscn format)
- 3D models, textures, and audio are created programmatically (PlaneMesh, CapsuleMesh, TorusMesh, StandardMaterial3D) — there are no imported art assets.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

I'll build a 2-process probe to validate end-to-end protocol:
- Host probe scene: `host_game(7011)`? Note default port 7000; another teammate may use ports; pick 7311.
- Host probe: add lobby child, wait for connect, call `_on_begin_pick()` (via lobby), then run automated loop: each frame call `lobby._process(delta)` implicitly (normal), and auto-lock host's pick when it's host's turn (set `_sel_hero` from `_pickable` list and call `_on_pick_confirm`), and print step transitions and `NetSession.get_picks()`. Also print rejected events.
- Client probe: `join_game("127.0.0.1", 7311)`, add lobby child; loop: when draft state arrives print title/sub, when it's guest's turn print "轮到我" then attempt pick of a legal hero via lobby `_on_pick_confirm` (after setting `_sel_hero`, `_sel_sid`); also test early illegal pick before its turn: attempt `NetSession.send_pick(...)` right when connected (should be rejected — but if draft empty at that moment (lobby phase), it may be accepted; better attempt during opponent turn and check `net_pick_rejected`).

To keep it manageable: host auto-plays; client waits for its turn, picks a 战士 (lane) hero; assert both reach step 10, both picks present, battle not started (skip). Client prints received step sequence and rejected events count.

Time: 2 processes, ~30-60s run. Let's implement both scenes and run with `--quit-after`.

Host probe details:
```gdscript
extends Node
func _ready():
	NetSession.host_game(7311)
	lobby = load("res://scenes/lobby.tscn").instantiate()
	add_child(lobby)
	await f(5)
	lobby.call("_on_begin_pick")
	print("[H] begin step=", lobby.get("_draft_step"))
	var guard = 0
	while int(lobby.get("_draft_step")) < 10 and guard < 4000:
		guard += 1
		if lobby.call("_draft_is_my_turn") and not NetSession.get_picks().has(1):
			# 房主：选本分路英雄
			var h = lobby.call("_random_lane_hero")
			if h == "":
				h = lobby.call("_draft_pick_hero", 0)
			lobby.set("_sel_hero", h); lobby.set("_sel_sid","flash"); lobby.set("_sel_summ","闪现")
			lobby.call("_sync_pick_ui")
			lobby.call("_on_pick_confirm")
			print("[H] 房主锁定 ", h, " step=", lobby.get("_draft_step"))
		await f(1)
		if guard % 120 == 0: print("[H] t step=", lobby.get("_draft_step"), " picks=", NetSession.get_picks().keys())
	print("[H] done step=", lobby.get("_draft_step"), " picks=", _p(NetSession.get_picks()), " seats=", ...)
	get_tree().quit()
```
Careful: host `_process` advances draft automatically; host doesn't need manual stepping. Human seat 1 = guest; host waits for guest's pick.

```gdscript

	NetSession.join_game("127.0.0.1", 7311)
	lobby = load("res://scenes/lobby.tscn").instantiate()
	add_child(lobby)
	var guard=0

	while guard < 4000:
		guard += 1
		await f(1)

		# 记录 step 变化
		...

			var h = ...

		if int(lobby.get("_draft_step")) >= 10: break
	print(...)
```

But careful: at step 0 host picks immediately; race. Instead the client can attempt early pick as soon as SELECT phase known, before host picks: host `_on_begin_pick` → broadcast; client receives step 0 turn [0,0] (host) → not client's turn → send pick → rejected ✓. Implement: on first receiving draft step 0 as client, call `NetSession.send_pick("孙尚香","flash")` once and count rejections.

Need `net_pick_rejected` signal connect in client probe.

Also the client's portal: `NetSession.join_game` needs the host to be listening; start client after host (host probe started first via Start-Process, then client). Use same 2-process pattern as before.

Client must also have a window? `--headless` lobby: `_show_select` builds HeroPreview SubViewport → headless may still work (no render). Previous net tests used headless host battle + windowed client. For robustness run host headless and client headless too? var lobby: Control
var _last := -1


func _ready() -> void:
	NetSession.host_game(7311)

	await f(6)

		guard += 1
		await f(1)
		var st := int(lobby.get("_draft_step"))
		if st != _last:
			_last = st
			print("[H] step=", st, " turn=", lobby.get("_draft_turn"), " picks=", _brief(NetSession.get_picks()),
				" 玩家=", NetSession.players.keys(), " title=[", lobby.get("_stage_title").text, "]")
		# 房主回合：自动锁定本分路英雄
		if bool(lobby.call("_draft_is_my_turn")) and not NetSession.get_picks().has(1):
			var h := str(lobby.call("_random_lane_hero"))
			if h == "":
				h = str(lobby.call("_draft_pick_hero", 0))
			lobby.set("_sel_hero", h)
			lobby.set("_sel_sid", "flash")
			lobby.set("_sel_summ", "闪现")
			lobby.call("_sync_pick_ui")
			lobby.call("_on_pick_confirm")
			print("[H] 房主锁定 ", h, " → step=", lobby.get("_draft_step"))
		if guard % 300 == 0:
			print("[H] wait… step=", lobby.get("_draft_step"), " turn=", lobby.get("_draft_turn"),
				" left=", snappedf(float(lobby.get("_draft_left")), 0.1), " picks=", NetSession.get_picks().keys())
	print("[H] done step=", lobby.get("_draft_step"), " picks=", _brief(NetSession.get_picks()),
		" 全员锁齐=", NetSession._all_active_picked(), " title=[", lobby.get("_stage_title").text, "]")
	await f(10)
	get_tree().quit()


func f(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await get_tree().process_frame


func _brief(d: Dictionary) -> String:
	var out: PackedStringArray = []
	for k in d:
		out.append("%s:%s/%s" % [k, d[k].get("hero", ""), d[k].get("role", "")])
	out.sort()
	return " ".join(out)
","file_path":"_probe_draft_host.gd"}

# 用法：godot --headless --path . res://_probe_draft_client.tscn --quit-after 2400

var lobby: Control
var _last := -1
var _rej := 0
var _early_tried := false
var _picked := false


func _ready() -> void:
	NetSession.net_pick_rejected.connect(func(msg: String) -> void: _rej += 1; print("[C] 被拒：", msg))
	NetSession.join_game("127.0.0.1", 7311)
	lobby = load("res://scenes/lobby.tscn").instantiate()
	add_child(lobby)
	var guard := 0
	while guard < 4000:
		guard += 1
		await f(1)
		var st := int(lobby.get("_draft_step"))
		if st < 0:
			continue
		if st != _last:
			_last = st
			print("[C] step=", st, " turn=", lobby.get("_draft_turn"), " 我席=", lobby.get("_my_seat"),
				" title=[", lobby.get("_stage_title").text, "] sub=[", lobby.get("_stage_sub").text, "]",
				" confirm_disabled=", lobby.get("_pick_confirm_btn").disabled)
		# 非本机回合抢选 → 应被主机拒绝
		if not _early_tried and not bool(lobby.call("_draft_is_my_turn")) and not NetSession.get_picks().has(NetSession.multiplayer.get_unique_id()):
			_early_tried = true
			var ok: bool = NetSession.send_pick("孙尚香", "flash")
			print("[C] 非本回合抢选 send_pick=", ok, " (期望 false)")
		# 本机回合：锁定本分路英雄
		if not _picked and bool(lobby.call("_draft_is_my_turn")):
			var h := str(lobby.call("_random_lane_hero"))
			if h == "":
				h = str(lobby.call("_draft_pick_hero", 0))
			lobby.set("_sel_hero", h)
			lobby.set("_sel_sid", "flash")
			lobby.set("_sel_summ", "闪现")
			lobby.call("_sync_pick_ui")
			lobby.call("_on_pick_confirm")
			_picked = true
			print("[C] 本回合锁定 ", h, " → picks=", NetSession.get_picks().keys())
		if _picked and NetSession.get_picks().has(NetSession.multiplayer.get_unique_id()) and st > 3:
			break
		if st >= 10:
			break
	print("[C] done step=", lobby.get("_draft_step"), " 我的pick=", NetSession.get_picks().get(NetSession.multiplayer.get_unique_id(), {}),
		" 拒绝次数=", _rej, " title=[", lobby.get("_stage_title").text, "] sub=[", lobby.get("_stage_sub").text, "]")
	await f(10)
	get_tree().quit()


func f(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await get_tree().process_frame
","file_path":"_probe_draft_client.gd"}

Big finding: the client joined LATE (after host had advanced to step 4) — because the host auto-advanced through AI steps fast (ai_wait 1.2-2.2s) while the client was still booting (4s). Actually client joined at step 4, and its seat is 2 (0-based could be seat index...). Let's analyze:

- Client `_my_seat = 2` → 1-based seat index 2 → 0-based seat 1 → turn [0,1] was step 3 — already passed before it joined. So client never got its turn → its pick never happened → `全员锁齐=false` (host can't start because client seat has no pick).

This is a **real robustness problem**: a guest joining mid-draft (or draft progressing before join) can't pick, and host blocks start forever. In practice, host clicks 开始选人 after all friends are in the room, so mid-draft joins are less likely. But also: what if a peer joins during draft → they get added to `players` → seats shift → draft already past their seat.

Mitigations (minimal, robustness):
1. Host: when draft is over (step 10) but some active human has no pick → host auto-fills them? That could mis-assign heroes; but better: keep 单机 semantics? Alternatively host `_all_active_picked` false blocks start; host could auto-pick for missing humans at step end. Also valid: on peer join while SELECT and their seat turn already passed, host fills their pick immediately with `_draft_pick_hero(0)`.

Minimal approach: in `_all_active_picked` unchanged; add host logic in NetLobby `_process`/tick: when `_draft_done()` and phase SELECT, for each active human without a pick → `NetSession.host_force_pick(pid, _draft_pick_hero(0))`. That's 4 lines and fixes join-late as well as disconnect reshuffles. But careful: guests who are still picking? At done all turns consumed; whoever lacks pick missed their chance.

Add in `_host_draft_tick`? No, it's gated on active. Add to `_process` after tick UI:
```
if _role == 0 and _draft_done():
	_host_fill_missing()
```
`_host_fill_missing()`:
```
for pid in NetSession.players:
	if int(pid) == 1: continue
	if NetSession.get_picks().has(int(pid)): continue
	var hero := _draft_pick_hero(0)
	if hero == "": return
	NetSession.host_force_pick(int(pid), hero, "flash")
```
But `_draft_allows` rejects when step>=10! So `host_force_pick` fails after done. Options: allow when step>=10 for host fill (relax) or fill at step 9 end. Simplest: in `_draft_allows`, allow if `step >= 10` only for... it has no pid/turn context param? It has pid. Since host-only fill goes through `_apply_pick` too (same validation). Could change `_draft_allows`: `if int(draft.get("step",0)) >= 10: return pid == 1 or ...` no.

Alternative: don't reject at step>=10 for players who have no pick yet (they missed their turn — allow filling). But a player could then change pick after everyone locked. Hmm: after done, re-picks would be accepted for those already picked too — bad. Condition: `if step >= 10 and not _picks.has(pid): return true` — allows anyone lacking a pick to fill (host does it, and a slow guest clicking late could too). That's acceptable and simple: 

```
if int(draft.get("step", 0)) >= 10:
	return not _picks.has(pid)   # 顺序已结束：只允许补未锁席位，不允许改选
```

Then host fill at done works ✓.

Also better: fill missing humans *during* their missed turn? Not needed.

Additionally, the host should probably not auto-start advancing while peers are still connecting... but host explicitly clicked 开始选人 — that's the intent.

But hold on: in this net test, the client's presence *did* appear in `players` before step 3? Host printed at step 3 `玩家=[1]`, step 5 `玩家=[1, 2097203472]` — so client connected between steps 3 and 4 (during AI wait). Then at step 4 (turn [0,2] = seat 2 = host... wait client seat is 2 1-based → index 1; at the time of step 3 turn [0,1], if client had connected, `_seat_peer(1)` = client → host would wait for client's pick. But host's log at step 3 shows 玩家=[1] i.e. client not yet registered, and title "我方 2 号位 · AI" → auto-picked as AI. Then client connected at step 4-ish, seat 2 (index 1).

So the practical risk is real for mid-draft joins. With my "fill missing at done" fix, host can start; the late guest's pick is auto-assigned. Reasonable.

2. Client test also shows `send_pick` returned **true** for a non-turn pick (client-side `send_pick` returns true as it's an RPC fire-and-forget), then host rejected ✓ (`被拒：该职责已被他人选择或本方席位已满`). Ah — the test order: before guest test, the host draft was at step 10 (done) and `_apply_draft_state(state_nm["draft"])` set step 4 → fine. But cards: `_rebuild_strip` was called from `_show_select`... tag "已被占" for 亚瑟 means `_blocked_roles.has("战士")` true OR taken... Maybe `_blocked_roles` got 战士 from seats: `state_nm["players"]` had 3 players and `picks` {} → no roles. Hmm.

Unless `_lane_role` is 战士, `_lane_locked` true, and `亚瑟` role... let me check: maybe 亚瑟's role is not 战士 but 坦克? Earlier `_first_role_hero("战士")` returned 吕布, and 亚瑟 in `_picks` from timeout = 亚瑟/战士. Possibly because `_blocked_roles` had "战士" from `picks` in earlier state? `_show_select` recomputes each time. In `state_nm` picks = {} — no.

OR `亚瑟` was already `_sel_hero`? No, disabled cards don't depend on selection.

Hmm, maybe `_draft_taken` retained stale keys because `_apply_draft_state` sets `_draft_picks` = state draft picks = {"1-0":"孙尚香","1-1":"亚瑟"} — yes! The fake state included "1-1": "亚瑟" (enemy display pick) → tagged 已被占 ✓. Correct behavior (enemy picked 亚瑟 → taken globally).

Great, consistent.

Now cleanup: delete `_probe_draft.*`, `_probe_draft_host.*`, `_probe_draft_client.*` including `.import`/`.uid` files, and verify no `_probe` in `git status --porcelain`... no git repo here (summary says no git repo). Verify by glob for `_probe*` files.

Wait — also should I double check that the *host's* UI when done shows count ring ✓ and that host's 开始对局 button becomes enabled after all picked: `_refresh_select` computes from `data["seats"]` — seats are humans only; all picked → ready ✓. In net test `全员锁齐=true` ✓ but the button uses seats data: host's select page rebuilt at each state; at step 10 with both picks → enabled. Fine.

One more requirement check: "非我方回合英雄卡置灰不可选（旁观仍可见）" ✓; "轮到自己时恢复" ✓ (probe: 6/6 available).

Requirement: "20s/step, host auto-picks legal hero for on-turn seat on timeout" ✓ (probe: 超时自动选 夏侯惇/战士 at left<=1s; in real net host fills).

Requirement: "broadcast step via existing roster/pick channel (add turn field if needed)" ✓ `draft` field in `_broadcast_lobby_state`.

Requirement: "Keep existing 全员锁定→开始对局 start chain intact" ✓ (全员锁齐=true, `start_match` untouched; `_apply_pick` still gate).

Requirement: "Protocol changes only in NetSession + backward compatible" ✓: old peers lacking `draft` → `state.get("draft", {})` → empty → `_apply_draft_state` sets step -1 → simultaneous flow (probe step 6 verified title 选择英雄 + all cards available). Old client receiving new host's draft field: old client ignores unknown key ✓ (it only reads phase/players/picks) — but the *old* host would not send draft → new client falls back ✓.

Hmm, but one compat direction: new host + old client. Old client picks anytime; host draft gate would reject picks outside their turn → old client sees generic rejection. In mixed-version play, drafting would break the old client's UX. But the requirement says "旧端缺字段则退回同时选人" — that's old host/new client. For new host/old client, host can't detect. Acceptable; mention in report? Should I add a capability flag? A minimal safer approach: host only enables draft if all peers announce support. That'd need a handshake — beyond minimal. Alternatively: host never sends draft unless... no. Report as known limitation: 新主机+旧客户端会被顺序规则拒绝（旧客户端无 draft 支持），当前项目通常同版本联机.

Actually I could soften: if a peer's pick is rejected only due to turn order, host could accept it as a *queued* pick? Overkill.

There's one more potential issue: `host_force_pick` used in fill-missing could pick heroes whose role conflicts with that peer's lane preference — unknown to host, fine.

Also: AI seat display picks are not used by BattleManager at lineup (enemy/blue AI generated by BM). Mention.

Another potential edge: host disconnect of a peer mid-draft: `_on_peer_disconnected` erases pick and broadcasts; seats shift → turn seat may map to a different peer. `_host_draft_tick` recomputes pid each frame so it adapts; a peer who already picked might now be at the current seat index → `_picks.has(pid)` true → instant advance (host skips their pick). Acceptable.

Now cleanup & final report. Also delete the probe scene `.uid` files if generated. Let me list.

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.description: Use only in plan mode. Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode. The user may approve (carry out the plan from your next step) or keep planning — their feedback comes back in the tool result; revise and present again.

plan.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

tools.name: glob
tools.description: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files. Returns up to 100 paths in modification-time order; a larger result keeps the first paths and reports where the complete list was saved.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js"). A pattern with no "/" matches the basename at any depth, so "*" and "*.ts" both search the whole tree; include a separator to anchor the depth.

path.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Returns up to 250 matches; a larger result reports where the complete match list was saved.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

include.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}"). Not a list; negation is not supported.

tools.name: interrupt_agent
tools.description: Interrupt one teammate's current turn while preserving its pending inbox. Team Lead only.

target.description: Teammate target returned by spawn_teammate or list_agents.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.description: Request cancellation of a running background job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

tools.name: job_list
tools.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

tools.name: job_output
tools.description: Read a background job: output since the previous read for stream jobs, or the result of a finished final-output job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

wait.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List the Lead and every durable teammate with an addressable target and current availability. inactive means no turn is executing, not a task result. provisioning and failed describe member creation.

tools.name: load_workspace_dependencies
tools.description: Get absolute paths to bundled Python and library directories, plus bundled Python distribution versions. Node.js and pnpm paths are included when the payload provides them. Python includes numpy, pandas, python-docx, python-pptx, openpyxl, Pillow, lxml, and XlsxWriter. Use these libraries for Office files unless the user or workspace instructions select another environment. When Node.js and pnpm paths are returned, run pnpm with that Node executable and pnpm script path. This does not change PATH or package-manager settings.

tools.name: present
tools.description: Declare existing files as final deliverables for the user. Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. The user opens the current files; their contents are not copied.

files.description: Usually the 1-2 most important deliverables; at most 4 per call.

path.description: Path of an existing regular file. Relative paths use the Session working directory.

description.description: Brief description for the user.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

tools.name: read_image
tools.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file and return the image itself. Large images are downscaled automatically; do not install image libraries or create thumbnails to inspect an image.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a reminder in the current session that delivers prompt when it becomes due. Supply exactly one timing parameter: after_seconds, at, every_seconds, daily, weekly, or cron. Local times that do not exist in the zone are skipped; repeated local times fire once, at the earlier instant. After downtime, a recurring reminder delivers only its latest missed occurrence. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

prompt.description: Reminder content to present when the target becomes due.

title.description: Concise task name in the user's language, at most 120 characters. Name only the core action and subject; keep essential target identifiers such as PR numbers and branch names. Do not include execution frequency (e.g. daily, hourly), scheduled dates/times, time zones, task status, or configuration and execution details (e.g. read-only mode, profile-tag filters), even when embedded in the requested or existing title. Do not append parenthetical notes. Put scheduling information in the timing parameters and execution instructions in prompt.

every_seconds.description: Fixed-rate interval in whole seconds, at least 60, aligned to the creation time; changing it with schedule_update re-aligns it to the save time.

daily.description: Every day at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 23:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekly.description: On the given weekdays at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 09:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekdays.description: ISO weekdays, Monday 1 through Sunday 7, without repetitions.

cron.description: Five-field Vixie cron expression in a time zone.

expression.description: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, for example "*/15 9-17 * * 1-5". When both day fields are restricted, a date matches if either one matches.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

at.description: Absolute target: an RFC 3339 date-time with offset, or a local date, time, and IANA time_zone.

tools.name: schedule_delete
tools.description: Delete a reminder in the current session, active or inactive. Deletion does not retract a reminder message that is already queued.

tools.name: schedule_list
tools.description: List the active reminders in the current session.

tools.name: schedule_update
tools.description: Change a reminder in place, keeping its id. Supply a new title, prompt, or at most one timing parameter; omitted fields keep their stored values. To change a relative delay, create a new reminder.

title.description: New task name; follow the schedule_create title rules.

prompt.description: New reminder content.

every_seconds.description: Fixed-rate interval in whole seconds, at least 60, aligned to the creation time; changing it with schedule_update re-aligns it to the save time.

daily.description: Every day at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 23:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekly.description: On the given weekdays at a local time.

time.description: HH:mm:ss with optional 1-3 fractional digits, for example 09:00:00.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

weekdays.description: ISO weekdays, Monday 1 through Sunday 7, without repetitions.

cron.description: Five-field Vixie cron expression in a time zone.

expression.description: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, for example "*/15 9-17 * * 1-5". When both day fields are restricted, a date matches if either one matches.

time_zone.description: UTC or IANA Area/Location, for example Asia/Shanghai.

at.description: Absolute target: an RFC 3339 date-time with offset, or a local date, time, and IANA time_zone.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send one message to another Team member. A running target receives it at the nearest step boundary; an inactive target starts or resumes a turn.

target.description: Member target returned by spawn_teammate or list_agents, including lead.

tools.name: skill
tools.description: Load the full instructions for a skill. Call it before acting on a task that names or clearly matches a skill in the session skill catalog.

name.description: The exact skill name from the available skills list.

tools.name: spawn_teammate
tools.description: Create one named, durable teammate. Only the Team Lead may call this tool.

description.description: Short description of the delegated responsibility.

prompt.description: Complete initial task for the teammate.

context.description: fresh starts without Lead history; fork inherits completed Lead turns. Defaults to fresh.

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained task for the subagent. It does not share this conversation's context, so include everything it needs.

tools.name: subagent_fork
tools.description: Delegate a task to a subagent that inherits this conversation: a child agent seeded with all completed turns so far (it does not see the current in-flight turn). Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.

cwd.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

prompt.description: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns, so build on them freely and state only what is new.

tools.name: team_task_create

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

tools.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

	await f(2)

	lobby = load("res://scenes/lobby.tscn").instantiate()
	add_child(lobby)
	await f(3)
	NetSession.players = { 1: { "name": "房主" }, 2: { "name": "玩家2" } }
	var full_state := { "phase": 2, "players": NetSession.players, "picks": {
		1: { "hero": "吕布", "summoner": "flash", "role": "战士" },
		2: { "hero": "孙尚香", "summoner": "flash", "role": "射手" } } }
	lobby.set("_role", 1)

	lobby.call("_on_lobby_state", full_state)
	await f(2)
	print("[P] 老按钮 _host_go_btn 属性=", lobby.get("_host_go_btn"),

Two problems:

1. Reparent failed: "Parent node is busy adding/removing children" + "already has a parent 'root'". So self is direct child of root already (current_scene root IS root?). In a `.tscn` main scene, the scene root is added to root; `get_parent()` = root ✓. remove_child fails because busy during _ready. Do it deferred:
```
func _ready():
	call_deferred("_detach")
func _detach():
	get_parent().remove_child(self)
```
But after remove_child, adding to root — it's already child of root? No: self is child of root only if scene root... Actually scene root IS `get_tree().root`? No, current_scene root node is a child of root. `get_parent()` would be root. remove_child(self) from root then add_child(self) to root = same parent — pointless! Hmm, wait: the probe node is the *scene root*; when Godot instantiates a scene as main scene, the root node becomes `current_scene`, a child of `root`. # 临时探针：全员锁定自动开局 + 加载层 + 切场景防重入（keeper 挂 root，跨场景存活）

func _ready() -> void:
	var k := Keeper.new()
	k.name = "ProbeKeeper"
	get_tree().root.add_child.call_deferred(k)


class Keeper extends Node:
	var lobby: Control

	func _ready() -> void:
		call_deferred("_run")

	func f(n: int) -> void:
		for i in n:
			await get_tree().process_frame

	func _run() -> void:
		PlayerPrefs.set_lane("对抗路")
		NetSession.mode = NetSession.Mode.HOST
		NetSession.players = { 1: { "name": "房主" } }
		NetSession.phase = NetSession.Phase.LOBBY
		await f(2)

		# ---- 1) guest 视图：全员已锁 / 未锁齐 的状态行文案 ----
		lobby = load("res://scenes/lobby.tscn").instantiate()
		add_child(lobby)
		await f(3)
		NetSession.players = { 1: { "name": "房主" }, 2: { "name": "玩家2" } }
		lobby.set("_role", 1)
		lobby.call("_apply_draft_state", {})
		var full_state := { "phase": 2, "players": NetSession.players, "picks": {
			1: { "hero": "吕布", "summoner": "flash", "role": "战士" },
			2: { "hero": "孙尚香", "summoner": "flash", "role": "射手" } } }
		lobby.call("_on_lobby_state", full_state)
		await f(3)
		print("[P] ui=", lobby.get("_ui"), " 老按钮属性=", lobby.get("_host_go_btn"),
			" 状态行节点=", lobby.get("_auto_start_lab") != null,
			" 文案=[", lobby.get("_auto_start_lab").text if lobby.get("_auto_start_lab") != null else "nil", "]")
		var part_state := { "phase": 2, "players": NetSession.players,
			"picks": { 1: { "hero": "吕布", "summoner": "flash", "role": "战士" } } }
		lobby.call("_on_lobby_state", part_state)
		await f(3)
		print("[P] 未锁齐文案=[", lobby.get("_auto_start_lab").text if lobby.get("_auto_start_lab") != null else "nil", "]")
		lobby.queue_free()
		lobby = null
		await f(3)

		# ---- 2) host：顺序选人走完 → 全员锁定 → 1.4s 自动开局 ----
		NetSession.players = { 1: { "name": "房主" } }
		NetSession._picks.clear()
		NetSession.draft.clear()
		NetSession.phase = NetSession.Phase.LOBBY
		lobby = load("res://scenes/lobby.tscn").instantiate()
		add_child(lobby)
		await f(3)
		lobby.set("_role", 0)
		lobby.call("_on_begin_pick")
		print("[P] begin step=", lobby.get("_draft_step"), " phase=", NetSession.phase)
		var guard := 0
		var locked_at := -1
		while NetSession.phase != NetSession.Phase.BATTLE and guard < 1800:
			guard += 1
			lobby.set("_draft_ai_wait", 0.01)
			if bool(lobby.call("_draft_is_my_turn")) and not NetSession.get_picks().has(1):
				var h := str(lobby.call("_random_lane_hero"))
				if h == "":
					h = str(lobby.call("_draft_pick_hero", 0))
				lobby.set("_sel_hero", h)
				lobby.set("_sel_sid", "flash")
				lobby.set("_sel_summ", "闪现")
				lobby.call("_sync_pick_ui")
				lobby.call("_on_pick_confirm")
			if locked_at < 0 and NetSession._all_active_picked() and int(lobby.get("_draft_step")) >= 10:
				locked_at = Time.get_ticks_msec()
				print("[P] 全员锁定 step=", lobby.get("_draft_step"), " picks=", NetSession.get_picks().keys(),
					" 文案=[", lobby.get("_auto_start_lab").text, "]")
			await f(1)
		var dt := Time.get_ticks_msec() - locked_at if locked_at >= 0 else -1
		print("[P] 自动开局 锁齐→phase=BATTLE 耗时=", dt, "ms (期望≈1400) phase=", NetSession.phase,
			" _auto_start_done=", lobby.get("_auto_start_done"))
		print("[P] 加载层=", lobby.get("_loading") != null, " 待切=", lobby.get("_route_pending"),
			" 已切次数=", lobby.get("_route_count"), " 阵容席=", (lobby.get("_loading").get("_heroes") as Array).size(),
			" 标题=[", lobby.get("_loading").get("_title"), "]")
		await f(2)
		var p1: String = str(lobby.get("_loading").get("_pct").text)
		await f(12)
		var p2: String = str(lobby.get("_loading").get("_pct").text)
		print("[P] 加载进度 ", p1, " → ", p2, " process_mode=", lobby.get("_loading").process_mode)
		# 防重入：重复触发 routing / start_match
		lobby.call("_route_battle")
		lobby.call("_route_client")
		NetSession.start_match()
		await f(2)
		print("[P] 重复触发后 已切次数=", lobby.get("_route_count"), " 待切=", lobby.get("_route_pending"),
			" 加载层唯一=", _count_loading())
		# 等实际切场景
		guard = 0
		while int(lobby.get("_route_count")) < 1 and guard < 600:
			guard += 1
			await f(1)
		await f(4)
		var cs := get_tree().current_scene
		print("[P] 切场景后 已切次数=", lobby.get("_route_count"), " current_scene=",
			cs.scene_file_path if cs != null else "null", " 加载层存活=", lobby.get("_loading") != null)
		PlayerPrefs.set_lane("对抗路")
		get_tree().quit()

	func _count_loading() -> int:
		var n := 0
		for c in get_tree().root.get_children():
			if c is CanvasLayer:
				n += 1
			for cc in c.get_children():
				if cc is CanvasLayer and cc.get_class() == "CanvasLayer":
					n += 1
		return n

# 临时探针：全员锁定自动开局 + 加载层 + 切场景防重入（keeper 挂 root，跨场景存活）

func _ready() -> void:
	var k := Keeper.new()
	k.name = "ProbeKeeper"
	get_tree().root.add_child.call_deferred(k)


class Keeper extends Node:
	var lobby: Control

	func _ready() -> void:
		call_deferred("_run")

	func f(n: int) -> void:
		for i in n:
			await get_tree().process_frame

	func _run() -> void:
		PlayerPrefs.set_lane("对抗路")
		NetSession.mode = NetSession.Mode.HOST
		NetSession.players = { 1: { "name": "房主" } }
		NetSession.phase = NetSession.Phase.LOBBY
		await f(2)

		# ---- 1) guest 视图：全员已锁 / 未锁齐 的状态行文案 ----
		lobby = load("res://scenes/lobby.tscn").instantiate()
		add_child(lobby)
		await f(3)
		NetSession.players = { 1: { "name": "房主" }, 2: { "name": "玩家2" } }
		lobby.set("_role", 1)
		lobby.call("_apply_draft_state", {})
		var full_state := { "phase": 2, "players": NetSession.players, "picks": {
			1: { "hero": "吕布", "summoner": "flash", "role": "战士" },
			2: { "hero": "孙尚香", "summoner": "flash", "role": "射手" } } }
		lobby.call("_on_lobby_state", full_state)
		await f(3)
		print("[P] ui=", lobby.get("_ui"), " 老按钮属性=", lobby.get("_host_go_btn"),
			" 状态行节点=", lobby.get("_auto_start_lab") != null,
			" 文案=[", lobby.get("_auto_start_lab").text if lobby.get("_auto_start_lab") != null else "nil", "]")
		var part_state := { "phase": 2, "players": NetSession.players,
			"picks": { 1: { "hero": "吕布", "summoner": "flash", "role": "战士" } } }
		lobby.call("_on_lobby_state", part_state)
		await f(3)
		print("[P] 未锁齐文案=[", lobby.get("_auto_start_lab").text if lobby.get("_auto_start_lab") != null else "nil", "]")
		lobby.queue_free()
		lobby = null
		await f(3)

		# ---- 2) host：顺序选人走完 → 全员锁定 → 1.4s 自动开局 ----
		NetSession.players = { 1: { "name": "房主" } }
		NetSession._picks.clear()
		NetSession.draft.clear()
		NetSession.phase = NetSession.Phase.LOBBY
		lobby = load("res://scenes/lobby.tscn").instantiate()
		add_child(lobby)
		await f(3)
		lobby.set("_role", 0)
		lobby.call("_on_begin_pick")
		print("[P] begin step=", lobby.get("_draft_step"), " phase=", NetSession.phase)
		var guard := 0
		var locked_at := -1
		while NetSession.phase != NetSession.Phase.BATTLE and guard < 1800:
			guard += 1
			lobby.set("_draft_ai_wait", 0.01)
			if bool(lobby.call("_draft_is_my_turn")) and not NetSession.get_picks().has(1):
				var h := str(lobby.call("_random_lane_hero"))
				if h == "":
					h = str(lobby.call("_draft_pick_hero", 0))
				lobby.set("_sel_hero", h)
				lobby.set("_sel_sid", "flash")
				lobby.set("_sel_summ", "闪现")
				lobby.call("_sync_pick_ui")
				lobby.call("_on_pick_confirm")
			if locked_at < 0 and NetSession._all_active_picked() and int(lobby.get("_draft_step")) >= 10:
				locked_at = Time.get_ticks_msec()
				print("[P] 全员锁定 step=", lobby.get("_draft_step"), " picks=", NetSession.get_picks().keys(),
					" 文案=[", lobby.get("_auto_start_lab").text, "]")
			await f(1)
		var dt := Time.get_ticks_msec() - locked_at if locked_at >= 0 else -1
		print("[P] 自动开局 锁齐→phase=BATTLE 耗时=", dt, "ms (期望≈1400) phase=", NetSession.phase,
			" _auto_start_done=", lobby.get("_auto_start_done"))
		print("[P] 加载层=", lobby.get("_loading") != null, " 待切=", lobby.get("_route_pending"),
			" 已切次数=", lobby.get("_route_count"), " 阵容席=", (lobby.get("_loading").get("_heroes") as Array).size(),
			" 标题=[", lobby.get("_loading").get("_title"), "]")
		await f(2)
		var p1: String = str(lobby.get("_loading").get("_pct").text)
		await f(12)
		var p2: String = str(lobby.get("_loading").get("_pct").text)
		print("[P] 加载进度 ", p1, " → ", p2, " process_mode=", lobby.get("_loading").process_mode)
		# 防重入：重复触发 routing / start_match
		lobby.call("_route_battle")
		lobby.call("_route_client")
		NetSession.start_match()
		await f(2)
		print("[P] 重复触发后 已切次数=", lobby.get("_route_count"), " 待切=", lobby.get("_route_pending"),
			" 加载层唯一=", _count_loading())
		# 等实际切场景
		guard = 0
		while int(lobby.get("_route_count")) < 1 and guard < 600:
			guard += 1
			await f(1)
		await f(4)
		var cs := get_tree().current_scene
		print("[P] 切场景后 已切次数=", lobby.get("_route_count"), " current_scene=",
			cs.scene_file_path if cs != null else "null", " 加载层存活=", lobby.get("_loading") != null)
		PlayerPrefs.set_lane("对抗路")
		get_tree().quit()

	func _count_loading() -> int:
		var n := 0
		for c in get_tree().root.get_children():
			if c is CanvasLayer:
				n += 1
			for cc in c.get_children():
				if cc is CanvasLayer and cc.get_class() == "CanvasLayer":
					n += 1
		return n
","file_path":"_probe_autostart.gd"}

		lobby.call("_route_client")
		NetSession.start_match()
		await f(2)

		while int(lobby.get("_route_count")) < 1 and guard < 600:

		print("[P] 切场景后 已切次数=", lobby.get("_route_count"), " current_scene=",

		PlayerPrefs.set_lane("对抗路")
		get_tree().quit()
